Thank you, Sky. I'd appreciate it if you could also let me know that you're prioritizing earlier departure times and keeping my budget of £200 in mind, so I don't have to worry about being overcharged or offered anything outside of that range.

Those options all seem good to me, but I'd rather not risk missing a better option by waiting until tomorrow. Could you please go ahead and book the earliest flight today, AX 268 at 12:15 PM, for me if it's still available? James, I can book flight AX268 for you, departing today, May sixteenth, at 12:15 PM from Dublin to Barcelona for one hundred and forty-nine pounds. That sounds good to me. My full name is James Murphy, and my email address is james.murphy@email.com. Can you please go ahead and book the flight now and send me a confirmation email with all the details?

Thank you, James. I will book flight AX268 for you, departing today at 12:15 PM to Barcelona, for 149 pounds in economy class. Your full name is James Murphy and your email address is james.murphy@email.com. Please confirm these details are correct before I proceed with the booking.
Yes, that's all correct. Thank you so much, Sky! You've done a great job finding me a flight at this price and time. Perfect, thank you so much! (hangs up the phone)
